mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 57 degrees under clear skies at Verona City Hall. The First Quarter moon is visible, and please note the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city is hosting a public information meeting on December 8 at the Verona Senior Center to discuss the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, including bridge replacements and planned detours. Additionally, residents are reminded to visit the Pellitteri website for information regarding waste and recycling collection schedules.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow or attend Wednesday Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
Regarding local public safety, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a woman unconscious in a vehicle, which resulted in her arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the wonderful Caramel Turtle. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
